verses: Round yonder marsh, there in the west, A flock of egrets fly. With graceful movement, like those birds, My visitors came nigh. Their fathers reigned where I reign now, But loyal are they to our Chou. There in their own states are they loved, Nor tired of are they here. Their fame with lapse of time shall grow Both day and night more clear. Their fathers reigned where I reign now, But loyal are they to our Chou.
